about: Phase 9G golden set: real requests, what a good run does with each, and where its expectation comes from. Grown from eval/seed-9d.json (ids r01–r10 keep their prompts). `modes` are the modes each request runs in; `expected.router` is the Auto decision (faithful | exploratory | ask | law); `declare` is what the Exploratory run declares — a Faithful run never declares; `reference` names the pattern fixture whose Exploratory screen must validate with exactly that declaration; `lawFixture` names the law-break fixture both modes must reject. Kept apart from the router few-shot by a test.
